model: counted-writer / loop summary (distinct from the transparent delegation wrapper)
relation_to_plan: Foundation for CAPABILITY_PLAN capability 3 (pointer-walk writes). Kept as its OWN proof model, not merged into capability 2, because a counted loop through an incremented pointer has different proof obligations than a delegation wrapper.
design: Infer a summary {dest_param, counter_param} for a user-defined callee that writes through an INCREMENTED pointer (aliasing a dest param) in a loop bounded by a decremented counter param. From body only; name never consulted. Additive (disjoint from frozen v1 ops).

proof_obligations_each_a_control.pointer_advancement: PASS - single-slot `*p =` (no advance) is extent 1, not count -> NO summary (no_advance control).
proof_obligations_each_a_control.advancement_multiplicity: PASS - two advances per iteration -> extent 2*count -> abstain, no summary (double_advance control).
proof_obligations_each_a_control.alias_identity: PASS - the advancing pointer must resolve to the dest PARAMETER via aliasing; an unrelated local -> NO summary (alien_walk control).
proof_obligations_each_a_control.signedness: PASS - counter signedness recorded from its type; a signed, not-provably-nonnegative count at a call site -> count_sign_unresolved, never proven safe (cw_signed control).
proof_obligations_each_a_control.zero_count: PASS - literal 0 count -> extent 0 -> proven safe, never a false overflow (cw(big,0) control).
proof_obligations_each_a_control.early_exits: PASS by soundness - `count` is a sound UPPER bound (early exits write fewer; the advance==1 gate forbids writing more than one element/iteration). The normalized fact schema carries no break/return nodes, so early exits are handled by this soundness argument, not by detecting the exit; the model never widens beyond count.
proof_obligations_each_a_control.conflicting_paths: PASS - more than one walked dest param or more than one counter -> abstain, no summary (two_dests control).

call_site_routing.literal_count: compared element-wise to dest capacity: <= -> deterministic_complete; > -> proven_oversized; 0 -> safe.
call_site_routing.dest_capacity_source: independently-established bare local fixed array only; else additional_evidence_required.

magma_dev_site_recovery: PASS on the REAL SSL004 ascii2ebcdic body (OpenSSL crypto/ebcdic.c @ 3bd5319, loop form) at its real call site ascii2ebcdic(ebcdic_buf[1024], q, num): frozen scanner recognized 0/1 -> counted-writer model recognizes (advance 1, unsigned size_t counter), binds capacity 1024, routes relationship_unresolved on the symbolic num with no false capacity claim.
separation_verified: cw/cw_signed are NOT transparent-wrapper summaries; _TIFFmemcpy delegation is NOT a counted-writer summary; ascii2ebcdic is a counted writer, NOT a wrapper summary; asserted in both harnesses.
